description: C4, a transport's self-destruct with a keyed passenger, on Show Down. s: an ATLAS loads TXCOM1 at (800, 700) and self-destructs (select it, then `keys <i> ctrl+d ctrl+d`: a keys call drops its first token); its cargo loop hits the commander with kind 3, a carried self-destruct: TransportedSelfDestructAs=TX_BLAST_S, 222. e: the same at x 4300 with TXCOME, which has TransportedExplodeAs alone, so its carried self-destruct is stock's SelfDestructAs. Each ring is two unarmed CORKROGs (29 918 HP) 260 either side of the load site: read their HP (+0x108) before and after. TX_BLAST_E takes 111 and TX_BLAST_S 222 from anywhere within 2000; stock's COMMANDER_BLAST takes thousands within 950. The cases are 3500 apart. Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into the instance's gamedir.
